title: Understand
body: Read the problem, talk to the people who have it, and write down what success looks like before any code.

title: Design
body: Sketch the data model, the API and the screens together, so the system and the interface fit each other.

title: Build
body: Typed, tested code in small pull requests. React and TypeScript on the front, Python and FastAPI on the back.

title: Ship
body: Deploy, monitor, fix what real users find. Shipping is the start of the work, not the end.
